title: Phishing simulation click rate
summary: Share of recipients who clicked a URL in a sanctioned phishing-simulation campaign within the evaluation window. A staff-awareness coverage KPI tied to NIS2 Article 21(2)(g) cyber-hygiene and training obligations. The phishing-triage playbook contributes the click telemetry because credential-harvest-branch responses account clicker identities against the simulation campaign tag.

target.rationale: Awareness-programme baseline; sustained rates above this trigger remediation training.

measurement.formula: 100 * count(distinct recipients with at least one OCSF URL Activity click event on a simulation-tagged URL) / count(distinct recipients targeted by the campaign).

inputs.name: clicks
inputs.description: URL Activity click events whose URL matches the simulation campaign tag

inputs.name: recipients
inputs.description: distinct recipients of the simulation campaign messages

external_refs.name: NIS2 Article 21(2)(g) — cyber hygiene and training
